component.name: Virtual Jaguar
component.summary: Atari Jaguar and Jaguar CD emulator

description.p: Virtual Jaguar emulates the Atari Jaguar console and its CD add-on: the 68000, GPU, DSP and Object Processor, the blitter, the CD drive controller, the Memory Track and GameDrive.
This desktop app runs the same emulator core as the RetroArch core and adds save states, shaders, cheats, controller remapping and a game library.
Games are not included. You need your own Jaguar cartridge dumps or CD images.
